question: Do the nominal CoreWeave and OpenInference rows justify one authoritative $0.119/M hurdle after capability evidence and failure sensitivity?

nominal.evidence: public exact endpoint price components; nominal only

capability_listed_cache_specified.evidence: public exact endpoint components plus listed API fields; not matched execution

methodology_matched.evidence: AA displayed blend; 10K input, single stream, 72-hour median

continuous_h100.evidence: analytical pooled-capacity interpretation; H100 throughput unmeasured

discrete_h100.evidence: analytical exact-trace fleet interpretation; H100 endpoint unmeasured

field_semantics.listed: source lists capability but does not prove execution
field_semantics.not_applicable: not a single endpoint property for the AA aggregate

Artificial_Analysis_reference.quantization: aggregate; per-provider labels include FP8 but no single reference quantization
Artificial_Analysis_reference.fresh_input_usd_per_million: partially exposed: Parasail 0.14; DeepInfra FP8 0.13; SiliconFlow FP8 0.13
Artificial_Analysis_reference.cache_read_usd_per_million: partially exposed: Parasail 0.10; other selected rows missing
Artificial_Analysis_reference.output_usd_per_million: partially exposed: Parasail 0.40; DeepInfra FP8 0.38; SiliconFlow FP8 0.40
Artificial_Analysis_reference.throughput: reported: Parasail 38.325 tok/s; Cerebras 1778.354 tok/s under AA harness
Artificial_Analysis_reference.latency: reported: Parasail TTFT 2.7075 s; Cerebras 0.6467 s under AA harness
Artificial_Analysis_reference.tools: listed for all 8 providers in page FAQ
Artificial_Analysis_reference.structured_outputs: listed JSON mode for all 8 providers
Artificial_Analysis_reference.implicit_caching: methodology describes cache-hit blend; provider cache write/storage not included

independent_retry.label: derived deterministic synthetic
independent_retry.assumption: Each attempt independently fails with probability p; a failed attempt consumes one full request cost and retry continues until success.

correlated_failure.label: derived deterministic synthetic
correlated_failure.assumption: A fraction q of requests experience one correlated outage episode causing exactly one additional full attempt; q is not inferred from uptime.
correlated_failure.generalization: For k extra full attempts, q_max=(target/base - 1)/k

sensitivity_model.interpretation: These are overhead bounds only. They do not model irrecoverable outages, quality failure, queueing, or provider capacity. Cases where base_cost >= target_cost have zero positive tolerance.

CoreWeave_nominal.reason: exact model/prices/API fields listed; revision, throughput, latency, quality and capacity missing

OpenInference_nominal.reason: exact model/prices/API fields listed; max completion is 8192 and revision, throughput, latency, quality and capacity missing

Venice.reason: cache-specified exact row and API fields listed; no matched campaign performance or quality

Artificial_Analysis.reason: methodology and benchmark medians are explicit, but workload and provider execution differ from campaign

limitations: OpenRouter status and uptime are source metadata, not request-level reliability or capacity guarantees.
No endpoint feed row binds the campaign checkpoint revision.
No frozen source supplies current throughput or latency for CoreWeave, OpenInference, or Venice.
AA is a separate 10K single-stream methodology and its aggregate feature claims do not establish exact provider execution.
Retry sensitivity is synthetic and deterministic; correlated outages can create unavailable service rather than finite overhead.
No quality, tool-call equivalence, multimodal eligibility, or production admission claim is made.
next_action: Use the measured H100 terminal, when independently available, to replace only the analytical H100 tiers; do not promote nominal provider rows without matched execution and quality evidence.
